How a soft arm moves

Each module is a silicone tube with three air chambers, 120° apart. Inflating a chamber lengthens that side, so the module bends away from it. Inflating all three equally makes the module longer without bending. Below 0.2 bar a chamber does not deform at all.

The arm hangs from the ceiling, so longer means lower. To pick something up:

  1. Open the gripper (0 bar) and swing over the object by raising the chamber on the side facing away from it.
  2. Raise all six pressures together to lower the gripper until the open fingers surround the object.
  3. Close the gripper to about 0.3–0.5 bar.
  4. Lower all pressures a little to lift, then swing over the bowl and set the gripper back to 0 bar.

6 chambers × 0–3 bar · gripper 0–1 bar · 5 sections per module, each 2 hinges + 1 slide · MuJoCo time step 0.2 ms · control 100 Hz
